pages.text: $(thing)Rift Shards$(/thing) are the endgame currency, earned from $(thing)Oblivion's Rift$(/thing) runs and $(t4)Tier 4$(end) boss kills. They are used for the $(bold)Mythic Gear Chase$(/bold) — the post-$(t4)Tier 4$(end) character improvement loop.$(br2)$(bold)Rift Keystone$(/bold): 5 Rift Shards + boss material. Required to open an Oblivion's Rift portal.

$(bold)Mythic Infusion$(/bold)$(br2)Mythic infusion elevates a Legendary item to Mythic tier (Mythic I–V). Each Mythic level:$(br2)$(li)Increases all existing affix values by ~15%$(li)Adds one additional socket$(li)Unlocks a visual effect on the item$(br2)Mythic V is the ceiling. Getting there requires deep Rift farming and is intentionally designed as the long-term endgame loop.
